2 عوّم السَّفِينَةَ , inf. n. تَعْوِيمٌ, He made the ship to swim [or float] in [or upon] the sea. (TA.) ＝
-A2- [J cites immediately after explaining عَامَةٌ in relation to a turban,] “وَعَامَةٍ عَوَّمَهَا فِى الهَامَةِ
” [Many a turn or twist, of a turban, which he turned, or twisted, upon the head]. (S.) ―
-b2- And تَعْوِيمٌ also signifies The putting, or placing, reaped corn in handfuls. (S, K.) ＝
-A3- See also the next paragraph, in two places.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
